purpose: Test whether CD169-derived across-track-conditioned residual-magnitude calibration transfers to fully unseen PF0501 x RB1202 data better than the same calibration with across-track information removed.

depth_sources.PF0501: FBT counterparts only of the 18 frozen FNV files with exact-overlap rows
depth_sources.RB1202: FBT counterparts only of the 26 frozen FNV files with exact-overlap rows

spatial_support.exact_polygon: frozen PF0501 ∩ RB1202 NCEI footprint intersection
spatial_support.PF0501_cell_across_track: median absolute across-track distance of contributing good PF0501 beams

unseen_residual.global_vertical_debias: NONE__primary matches frozen CD169 library residual semantics exactly

model_comparison.V2: For each calibration channel and unseen across-track bin, use that channel's empirical absolute-residual distribution from the same frozen bin.
model_comparison.BASELINE: For the same calibration channel, pool empirical absolute residuals from all four across-track bins, removing across-track conditioning but changing no source data.

bin_eligibility.shared_bin_set: A bin is evaluated only if unseen n>=50 and all four calibration channels have n>=30.

primary_metrics.within_channel_aggregation: weighted mean over shared eligible bins using unseen bin counts as weights
primary_metrics.channel_pass: V2 weighted Wasserstein < BASELINE weighted Wasserstein AND V2 weighted tail error < BASELINE weighted tail error

overall_verdict.PASS_UNSEEN_TRANSFER: at least 3 of 4 frozen calibration channels satisfy channel_pass

secondary_report_only: unseen per-bin n, median absolute residual, p90, p99, fraction >=50m, >=100m, >=150m
